messages:
alyssa_cs: Heads up — HelixCorp renewal lands in 30 days. Procurement pushed back on the 10% list price increase. Theyre asking if we can do a 9mo term or keep current price for confirmed PO before EOM. Quote: https://app.redwood/quote/RC-8921 :warning:
jordan_ae: Thanks. Customer reaction expected. Can we propose 9mo at current price as a concession? If finance ok we can sign faster. I'll own pricing sign-off with CS help. :+1:
sam_billing: Quick checklist — we need a PO number and vendor code to process. If they give PO, we invoice Net30. If PO delayed we can accept CC fallback for first month but need finance pre-approval. Required PO format (example):
```
PO: HELIX-2026-001
Vendor code: 44322-RED
Billing entity: Redwood Inc. (US)
```
Please confirm billing entity and whether they want consolidated invoice.
tess_legal: If KMS/HSM is being added to SOW that triggers a privacy/review. I need the customer's KMS spec and expected data flows. Also highlight any redlines now so Legal can turn the SOW around in ~3 business days.
alyssa_cs: They said KMS will be used only for key wrapping (no external logs). Estimated integration 3-4 weeks by their infra. Customer is open to 9mo at current price if we guarantee no mid-term increases. I sent the docsend with latest SOW: https://docsend.com/d/helix-renewal-2026 :paperclip:
legal-bot: Automated flag: KMS-PRIVACY-REVIEW required. Ticket created: #KMS-4201. ETA: 72h.
sam_billing: Noted. If Legal requires changes that delay signature past EOM we can do provisional invoice for initial months via CC, but need revenue ops sign-off for credit terms. Also need vendor code ASAP to avoid AP delays.
jordan_ae: @mike_rev can you confirm provisional credit and early-invoice workflow? Will finance approve CC fallback if PO takes >14 days?
mike_rev: Yep — finance can approve a provisional CC invoice for up to 2 months while PO is processed, provided AE + CS attach an exec email confirming commitment. Will need final PO or contract within 60 days for credits to apply. :white_check_mark:
alyssa_cs: Great — I'll get exec confirmation from Helix tomorrow and upload PO example into the ticket. Will update this thread once I have the signed SOW or PO. Thanks all. :v:
